info.title: Factory REST Job API
info.description: Authenticated API for submitting and inspecting bounded Factory jobs. A successful agent process or PR publication is not an independent correctness verdict.

get.description: Unauthenticated process-liveness probe. It does not establish that the service can accept work.

405.description: The request used a method other than GET; the response has no body.

get.description: Unauthenticated readiness probe. Readiness checks can be capacity-limited; a failed, unavailable, or saturated check returns not_ready.

405.description: The request used a method other than GET; the response has no body.

get.description: Read-only bearer-authenticated listing with role-dependent response and pagination. The legacy shared API key and named operator credentials receive the operator JobPage: jobs ordered by immutable admission sequence, oldest first, with snapshot_sequence and next_sequence; continue with the returned next_sequence as after and the same snapshot_sequence. Named submitter credentials receive only their own jobs in SubmitterJobPage and use the opaque next_cursor as cursor. Submitter cursors are held in process memory, bound to that principal, expire after 15 minutes, and become invalid on restart. Both page types are bounded to 1–100 items (default 50) and expose only id, status, created_at, and updated_at. The response omits request/task text, provider details, events, logs, paths, and admission sequence metadata for submitters. Status and updated_at are current per-page values; the snapshot boundary freezes membership, not lifecycle state.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Operator listing only: next_sequence returned by the preceding page; required with snapshot.

parameters.name: snapshot
parameters.description: Operator listing only: snapshot_sequence returned by the first page; required with after and forbidden with cursor.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Named submitter listing only: opaque next_cursor from the previous page; mutually exclusive with after and snapshot.

200.description: A bounded page of safe job summaries.

schema.description: JobPage for the legacy shared key or named operator; SubmitterJobPage for a named submitter.

405.description: The request used an unsupported method; Allow lists GET and POST.

Allow.description: Allowed methods for the collection path.

post.description: Admits a bounded request for an operator-configured repository alias. Idempotency-Key retries are scoped to the authenticated principal: same-principal retries with the same normalized payload return the retained job, while reuse for different payload conflicts; different principals may use the same key independently. Optional issue_provenance stores bounded GitHub source identity, exact snapshot version, canonical issue URL, and sanitized title only; the submitted task remains ordinary visible request.task content. Across principals and idempotency keys, the tuple (tracker, source_repository, issue_number, version) maps to one retained job. A tuple already reserved by another principal/job returns a generic sanitized conflict that does not reveal the owner or job; changed complete content also conflicts. A changed version is a distinct identity. Provenance is caller-supplied metadata and the server does not fetch GitHub or verify snapshot authenticity. Named submitters may submit but can inspect only their own jobs; operators can inspect all jobs. Memory persistence is volatile and jobs are lost on process restart. With SQLite, queued jobs resume after restart, but interrupted running jobs are not replayed and require operator investigation. Configured PR publication is a delivery condition, not proof of correctness; agent-reported completion is not an independent correctness verdict. Responses omit credentials, host paths, raw logs, and agent transcripts, but include the submitted request fields.

requestBody.description: JSON body limit is operator-configurable up to 2 MiB; task limit is operator-configurable up to 256 KiB. The schema documents the maximum supported task length; deployments may enforce smaller limits. Repository must be an alias configured by the operator, not a filesystem path.

202.description: The job was admitted or an identical idempotent retry was replayed.

409.description: The principal-scoped idempotency key conflicts with a different request, or the globally unique issue-provenance tuple is already reserved by another principal/job. Provenance conflicts are generic and do not disclose the existing owner or job.

413.description: The request body exceeds the configured byte limit.

415.description: The request Content-Type is not application/json.

503.description: The service is not ready, is shutting down, or has reached queue or registry capacity.

405.description: The request used the wrong method; a sanitized ErrorEnvelope with code method_not_allowed is returned.

get.description: Returns a safe snapshot including the submitted request and bounded verification evidence. It excludes credentials, host paths, raw logs, and agent transcripts. A verification check reports only its generated label and outcome; recorded limitations can state that no checks were configured and that agent completion is not an independent correctness verdict.

405.description: The request used the wrong method; a sanitized ErrorEnvelope with code method_not_allowed is returned.

get.description: Returns retained lifecycle events and a truncation indicator. Event types and messages are filtered to a safe allowlist; credentials, host paths, raw logs, and agent transcripts are not returned.

405.description: The request used the wrong method; a sanitized ErrorEnvelope with code method_not_allowed is returned.

get.summary: Stream bounded lifecycle events for a job
get.description: Read-only bearer-authenticated Server-Sent Events stream for one retained job. Events are read from bounded retained history, in monotonically increasing per-job sequence order. Event IDs are decimal sequence cursors; reconnect with Last-Event-ID to replay only newer retained events without duplicates. If the cursor has expired, the HTTP response is 409 cursor_expired before streaming, or an in-stream reset event is sent and the connection closes; fetch GET /v1/jobs/{id} and /history, then reconnect without a cursor to start from retained history. If history is already truncated at initial connect for an active job, the route returns 409 so status/history can establish the baseline; terminal jobs replay the retained tail and close. If the terminal lifecycle event was evicted, a synthetic terminal_snapshot control frame reports only the current terminal status and has no event ID. Events expose only timestamp and allowlisted lifecycle type, never messages, requests, provider details, logs, credentials, or paths. A 250 ms history poll closes the initial-read/subscription race without subscriber queues. The process admits at most 16 streams; excess requests fail with 503 stream_capacity. Each stream sends a 15 second heartbeat, has a 25 second maximum lifetime and a 2 second write deadline, and releases capacity on disconnect/closure. Clients should reconnect as needed or fall back to polling GET status/history.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Last decimal event sequence delivered by the prior stream.

200.description: Server-Sent Events stream with bounded JobEvent frames.

schema.description: SSE frames conform to JobEvent; heartbeats are SSE comments, reset controls have event reset, and an evicted terminal lifecycle event is represented by terminal_snapshot with the current status only.

409.description: Cursor is expired or active-job history was truncated; read status and history before reconnecting.

503.description: The service is not ready or all 16 event stream slots are occupied.

405.description: The request used the wrong method; a sanitized ErrorEnvelope with code method_not_allowed is returned.

post.description: Bodyless, job-scoped cancellation request. A queued job is canceled before execution and returns 200; a running job remains running with cancellation_requested=true and returns 202 while its worker exits. Cancellation does not erase workspaces or reverse provider side effects. If provider effects may have occurred, the outcome remains failed/inspectable for operator recovery rather than being reported as canceled or successful. This action is not a correctness verdict.

200.description: The queued job was canceled before execution.

202.description: Cancellation was requested for a running job; execution has not necessarily stopped.

409.description: The job is terminal or otherwise cannot be canceled.

405.description: The request used the wrong method; a sanitized ErrorEnvelope with code method_not_allowed is returned.

post.description: Bodyless, authenticated operator action. Eligibility is limited to SQLite jobs with a persisted provider attempt/outcome and retained workspace: startup-interrupted running jobs or failed jobs. It validates retained repository/branch/commit identity and performs read-only provider confirmation; it does not run the harness or write to the provider. Only a matching confirmed open PR and successful atomic recording can mark the job succeeded. Memory storage has no durable startup-recovery classification and does not support this recovery. Failed or ambiguous reconciliation remains unresolved for operator investigation. PR publication and agent completion are not independent correctness verdicts.

200.description: The provider outcome was read-only confirmed and recorded, or the already-reconciled snapshot was returned.

409.description: Reconciliation is unavailable or the job is ineligible, mismatched, ambiguous, or could not be durably updated. The job remains unresolved.

405.description: The request used the wrong method; a sanitized ErrorEnvelope with code method_not_allowed is returned.

post.summary: Record an interrupted job as failed
post.description: Bodyless, authenticated operator action available only for SQLite jobs classified by this store instance as interrupted while running and having no persisted provider attempt or outcome. It records only the selected failed disposition and a bounded audit event, retaining existing verification evidence. It cannot accept caller-supplied evidence or declare success. Memory storage has no durable interrupted-job classification. This disposition is not a correctness verdict.

409.description: The job is not eligible for this operator disposition.

405.description: The request used the wrong method; a sanitized ErrorEnvelope with code method_not_allowed is returned.

post.summary: Record an interrupted job as canceled
post.description: Bodyless, authenticated operator action available only for SQLite jobs classified by this store instance as interrupted while running and having no persisted provider attempt or outcome. It records only the selected canceled disposition and a bounded audit event, retaining existing verification evidence. It cannot accept caller-supplied evidence or declare success. Memory storage has no durable interrupted-job classification. This disposition is not a correctness verdict.

409.description: The job is not eligible for this operator disposition.

405.description: The request used the wrong method; a sanitized ErrorEnvelope with code method_not_allowed is returned.

get.description: Returns bounded aggregate counts and capacity indicators only, without job IDs, requests, events, provider details, host paths, or credentials. Memory-mode records are volatile and lost at restart. SQLite queued jobs resume after restart; interrupted running jobs require operator investigation and are not replayed.

405.description: The request used the wrong method; a sanitized ErrorEnvelope with code method_not_allowed is returned.

bearerAuth.description: Send the operator-provisioned shared API key or a configured named-principal bearer token as Authorization: Bearer <token>; never place credentials in a URL or job payload. The shared legacy key is operator-wide. Named submitter credentials are restricted to submission and owner-filtered inspection/listing; named operator credentials have operator-wide job and operator-action access.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Non-empty retry key, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes. Identical normalized requests map to the same retained job; a different payload with the same key conflicts. Retention is bounded by the configured store and persistence mode.

JobId.name: id
JobId.description: Opaque job identifier returned at admission.

InvalidRequest.description: The request is malformed, invalid, or contains unsupported fields.

Unauthenticated.description: A single valid bearer credential is required.

NotFound.description: The requested job does not exist or is not exposed.

NotReady.description: The service is not accepting requests.

InternalError.description: An internal error occurred; implementation details are redacted.

repository.description: Operator-configured repository alias; it is not a URL or filesystem path.

task.description: UTF-8 task text, at most 256 KiB by byte length; operator configuration may impose a smaller limit. Requests reject control characters other than tab, carriage return, and line feed.

issue.description: Optional positive issue number as context only; when issue_provenance is supplied, it must match issue_number.

replayed.description: True when the retained job was returned for an identical idempotency key or exact issue-provenance request.

snapshot_sequence.description: Admission-sequence ceiling captured on the first page; zero denotes an empty store.

next_sequence.description: Continuation cursor, present only when has_more is true.

next_cursor.description: Opaque, principal-bound server cursor. Empty when has_more is false. Process-memory state expires after 15 minutes and is lost on restart.

JobSnapshot.description: Safe public job snapshot. The request is caller-provided text; credentials, host paths, raw logs, and agent transcripts are not exposed.

submitted_by.description: Stable Factory principal ID that admitted the job. Existing jobs migrated from the shared API key are attributed to legacy-shared; the original human submitter is unknown.

IssueProvenance.description: Bounded GitHub issue snapshot identity metadata only. It contains no issue body, which remains visible in the ordinary JobRequest.task. Caller metadata is not authenticated or verified by the server against GitHub.

title.description: Sanitized title; control characters are rejected. The server enforces a maximum UTF-8 byte length of 4096; schema maxLength counts characters.

ProviderOutcome.description: Confirmed provider PR identity. Presence records a provider outcome, not merge approval or a correctness verdict.

repository.description: Provider repository name, not a host filesystem path.

enum: No operator-configured verification checks were run.
Agent-reported completion is not an independent correctness verdict.

name.description: Generated safe check label; check output and command are never returned.

id.description: Monotonic per-job event sequence used as Last-Event-ID.

truncated.description: True when older events were omitted from bounded history.

message.description: Only allowlisted fixed messages are returned; unrecognized messages are blanked.
Sanitized error message; internal paths, credentials, and implementation details are not returned.
